artifact_partitions.rule: The 38 La Poste MQ rows become 35 code/commune assertions over 35 pair-specific postal nodes representing 30 postal codes and have no geometry authority.
Only fixed geo.api.gouv.fr coordinates enter geometry; source, date, licence, digest, multiple, shared and Ligne 5 cases, and derived class remain visible.
